params.name: ids
params.description: Filter notes with a comma separated list of internal ids

params.name: debtor_ids
params.description: Filter notes with a comma separated list of debtor internal ids

params.name: invoice_ids
params.description: Filter notes with a comma separated list of invoice internal ids

params.name: credit_case_ids
params.description: Filter notes with a comma separated list of credit case internal ids

params.name: updated_after
params.description: ISO8601 UTC Timestamp to filter records updated after it

params.name: fields
params.description: JSON object defining fields to receive (e.g {"only": ["field1", {"field2": ["field3"]}]})

params.name: cursor
params.description: The record identifier after which to start the page

params.name: per_page
params.description: How many records will be returned per page, (1..500), defaults to 100
